Let me analyze this carefully.

The question asks about Section 2(b)(2)(C) and whether it applies to Bob in 2014.

The facts:
- Alice and Bob got married on Feb 3rd, 1992
- Alice died on July 9th, 2014

Section 2(b)(2)(C) states:
"(C) a taxpayer shall be considered as married at the close of his taxable year if his spouse (other than a spouse described in subparagraph (B)) died during the taxable year."

So this section says that if a spouse dies during the taxable year, the taxpayer is considered as married at the close of that taxable year.

Alice died on July 9th, 2014, which is during the 2014 taxable year. Therefore, under Section 2(b)(2)(C), Bob would be considered as married at the close of his 2014 taxable year.

The question says "Section 2(b)(2)(C) applies to Bob in 2014."

This is asking whether the statute section applies to Bob. Based on the facts:
- Bob's spouse (Alice) died during 2014 (on July 9th, 2014)
- Section 2(b)(2)(C) says a taxpayer is considered as married at the close of the taxable year if his spouse died during the taxable year

So yes, Section 2(b)(2)(C) does apply to Bob in 2014 because Alice died during that taxable year.

The answer should be "Entailment" because the claim is true given the statute and facts.
